one_liner: Collaborative all-in-one doc platform with tables, automations, and API

evidence.claim: Coda (now Superhuman Docs) offers a documented public REST API covering docs, pages, tables, rows, formulas, and controls
evidence.quote: The Superhuman Docs API is a RESTful API that lets you programmatically interact with data in Superhuman Docs (formerly Coda)

evidence.claim: API supports full CRUD on rows and doc management, indicating a substantial endpoint surface
evidence.quote:
List and search documents
*   Create new docs and copy existing ones
*   Share and publish docs
*   Discover pages, tables, formulas, and controls
*   Read, insert, upsert, update, and delete rows

evidence.claim: API base path is stable and versioned
evidence.quote: This API uses a base path of `https://coda.io/apis/v1`.

evidence.claim: Authentication is via a user-generated API key/token
evidence.quote: Initializes a Coda instance using API key store in environment variables under CODA_API_KEY

evidence.claim: Vendor itself ships/documents an official MCP server for LLM integrations
evidence.quote: you may also want to consider using the [Superhuman Docs MCP server](https://docs.superhuman.com/resources/guides/getting_started_with_coda_mcp). It's optimized for LLM usage patterns

notes: Coda has rebranded to 'Superhuman Docs'; developer docs now live at docs.superhuman.com, though the API base remains coda.io/apis/v1. Older references (Python wrapper) use the deprecated v1beta1 path. Writes are asynchronous: endpoints return HTTP 202 with a requestId and edits are queued. Rate limits are tight for writes (10 POST/PUT/PATCH per 6 seconds; 5 per 10s for doc content). Several third-party MCP servers exist (e.g. orellazri/coda-mcp) in addition to the official one. OAuth2 content on Coda's site concerns building Packs that call third-party APIs, not authenticating to Coda itself. API tokens are user-generated (Reddit: 'a user can provide their Coda api token to connect'); free-tier availability of tokens is not explicitly confirmed in the material but no paywall or approval gate is documented.
